description: Modern downloader supporting HTTP, BitTorrent/Magnet, FTP, M3U8, MPEG-DASH, eD2k, plus YouTube/Bilibili/GitHub/HuggingFace.
notes: Portable mode: app data (config, log, feature packs, runtime packs) lives in the GhostDownloader folder next to the exe, which is persisted to Scoop's persist dir.
Portable mode is triggered by that folder existing - keep $dir\GhostDownloader in place.
Turn off Settings > Software > 'Check update at startup' so Scoop stays the single source of truth for upgrades (the bundled updater would overwrite files Scoop owns).
4.4.5 is a security release: keep 'Verify SSL certificates' enabled in download settings.
